mapper.select:
select LINING_CODE, GROUP_CONCAT(sm.MACHINE_ID ORDER BY sm.MACHINE_ID SEPARATOR ',') as machine_ids from T_NC_SPECIFY_MACHINE sm inner join T_NC_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_id = m.id where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0'
and sm.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} /*限制作业 类型*/
and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by LINING_CODE
select ID, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, WIDTH_MIN, WIDTH_MAX, THICK_MIN, THICK_MAX, QUATA, CLASS_SHIFT, OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS, STATUS, REMARK from T_NC_MACHINE_INFO where STATUS = '0' and DEL_FLAG = '0'
